parts.name: Rotation
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotating metal cover of a USB flash drive made of aluminum, which protects the USB connector when not in use.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a protective swivel cover that rotates around the base body to shield or expose the USB connector.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around a pivot point, typically up to 180 degrees, allowing the user to open or close the USB connector.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the USB flash drive made of durable plastic, housing the memory chip and USB connector.
parts.Functional_description: It contains the electronic components and provides the structural support for the USB connector and rotating cover.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the fixed base for the rotating cover.
